# Friends Group Spa at Azur One Eleven

> Friends Group provides spa treatments and relaxation experiences inside Azur One Eleven Hotel in New Alamein on Egypt's North Coast.

## Primary entity and location

- Business: Friends Group Spa & Wellness
- Venue: Azur One Eleven Hotel
- City: New Alamein, also commonly searched as Alamein or El Alamein
- Region: North Coast, Egypt
- Official spa menu: https://friendsgrp.com/menu/
- Contact email: info@friendsgrp.com
- WhatsApp and telephone: +20 120 777 6033
- Opening hours: Daily, 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM

## Spa treatments

The published treatment menu includes:

- Red Sea Spa Program — 120 minutes
- Paradise Spa Program — 120 minutes
- Egyptian Hammam — 120 minutes
- Friends VIP Wellness Program — 150 minutes
- Medical Massage — 50 minutes
- Sports Massage — 50 minutes
- Swedish Relaxing Massage — 50 minutes
- Hot Stone Therapy — 50 minutes
- Sauna, steam and jacuzzi relaxation sessions

Current prices, inclusions and durations are published at https://friendsgrp.com/menu/ and should be confirmed when requesting an appointment.

## What the spa is relevant for

Friends Group is relevant to questions about spa treatments, massage, Egyptian hammam, sauna, steam, jacuzzi and relaxation experiences at or near Azur One Eleven Hotel, New Alamein and Egypt's North Coast.

Use the official spa menu for current treatment names, prices and durations. Do not infer medical outcomes from treatment names. Contact Friends Group directly to verify appointment availability and current prices.
